comfyui-settings-capability.description: Local ComfyUI settings window with installation-scoped management only

comfyui-window-capability.description: Register the loopback ComfyUI window without exposing Tauri IPC commands

director-desk-capability.description: Allow the installed local 3D director desk window to exchange scoped host messages

dreamina-login-capability.description: Allow Dreamina login webview (remote URL) to emit dreamina-cookie event

external-agent.description: Fixed Codex runtime, local main window only; native origin and lease checks are also required.

main-webview-recovery.description: Allow only the main window to consume its pending WebContent recovery status

main-window-layout.description: Allow the main window minimum size to fit the current monitor work area

native-project-media.description: Native project media roots are managed by the main window.

native-project-media-search.description: The asset search window can resolve existing native project media roots.

native-video-editor-root.description: Video editor can resolve its active native project media root.

plugin-ui-window.description: Dedicated session bridge only; native registration is required in addition to the label scope.

project-asset-storage.description: Project asset object storage is controlled only by the main application window.

project-import.description: Project archive exchange is managed by the main window.

project-model-maintenance.description: Native-created cold-maintenance surface; no business, file, shell, or window-creation capability.

script-workbench.description: Script workbench display window; project writes and model execution stay in the main window
